## Data policy

Prices are time-stamped US offer snapshots when available. Missing prices are not estimated. Product facts and retailer links should be checked against the cited source URL on each product record.

This file is a curated navigation layer; it does not replace robots.txt, sitemap.xml, structured data, or the public pages themselves.
